# Spec Kit agent commands — installed artifacts OUTSIDE .specify/.
#
# Placement: the ROOT .gitignore. Never append this to .specify/.gitignore:
# a subdirectory .gitignore cannot match paths outside its own directory
# (`../.pi/prompts/` does nothing), and `specify init --force` rewrites the
# managed .specify/.gitignore anyway.
#
# The patterns are prefix-scoped (`.../speckit*`, not the whole directory) so
# hand-written prompts and third-party skills living in the same directories
# stay visible. They are also agent-agnostic: every generated file or skill
# folder is named `speckit...` (`speckit.plan.md`, `speckit-plan/SKILL.md`,
# `speckit.plan.agent.md`, `speckit-events.ts`), including commands that
# extensions contribute.
#
# Keep the list in sync with `.specify/integration.json`: add the line for an
# integration when you install it. For an integration that is missing here
# (new integration, `generic` with a custom --commands-dir), read the exact
# paths from `.specify/integrations/<key>.manifest.json` — see
# references/vcs-policy.md ("Agent command directories").
#
# Verified against specify 1.0.13.

# --- Not covered on purpose, commit these ---
# Shared agent configuration the integration merges into, not an artifact:
# .claude/settings.json, .vscode/settings.json, opencode.json,
# .codex/config.toml, .github/copilot-instructions.md
#
# Skills installed by tools other than specify (e.g. project-scoped
# .claude/skills/<name>/, .agents/skills/<name>/) do not match `speckit*`:
# commit or ignore them, but decide explicitly — never ignore the whole
# skills directory.
#
# Out of project scope: the hermes integration installs to ~/.hermes/skills.
